title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories with AI agent integration
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF to enable semantic search, faceted filtering, and capability clustering. It exposes data via a static web UI, a REST API, and an MCP server for AI agents.
how_its_built: Python backend using sentence-transformers for embeddings and SQLite-vec for vector storage. The indexing pipeline fetches repo metadata and READMEs from the GitHub API. The web frontend is a static HTML/JS application served from S3/CloudFront. AI agent access is provided via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
how_to_apply: Use the CLI to index your own GitHub account, then serve the web UI locally or deploy to AWS. Integrate with AI coding assistants like Claude Code via the MCP server to allow them to search your codebase contextually.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across repository READMEs
Automatic clustering of repositories into capability categories
MCP server for AI agents to search and retrieve repo details
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
Static web UI with autocomplete and shareable search URLs
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
